status.note: Written in-session from the underlined passages. Redrafted after sentence 13 was found to be underlined. Marathi connective prose needs a native editor.

essay.mr: प्रश्न साधा आहे — नाम सद्गुरूकडूनच घ्यावें लागतें कां? उत्तरहि साधें आहे: भगवंताचें नांव स्वतःसिद्ध आहे व परिपूर्ण आहे; त्याला दुसऱ्या कोठूनहि पूर्णता प्राप्त होण्याची नसते{{2}}.
essay.en: The question is a plain one — must the Name be received from a Sadguru? The answer is plain too: God's Name is self-established and complete in itself; it has no completeness to receive from anywhere else{{2}}.

essay.mr: म्हणजे सद्गुरु नामांत कांहीं भर घालत नाहीं. मग तो देतो काय?
essay.en: So the Sadguru adds nothing to the Name. Then what is it that he gives?

essay.mr: तो त्या नामाचे पाठीशीं संतरूपानें असतो, आणि त्यामुळें “मी नामस्मरण करतों” अशा तऱ्हेचा अहंकार होण्याला वाव राहात नाहीं{{5}}. नाम तेंच राहतें; बदलतो तो घेणारा.
essay.en: He stands behind that Name in the form of a saint, and because of that there is no room left for the pride of thinking “I am doing the remembrance”{{5}}. The Name stays the same; what changes is the one taking it.

essay.mr: पण सद्गुरु अजून भेटला नसेल तर? सद्गुरुभेट होईपर्यंत आपण नामस्मरण करीत राहणें जरूर आहे; कारण तेंच नामस्मरण सद्गुरूची भेट करवून देईल{{7}}. वाट पाहणें ही अट नाहीं — नामच तो मार्ग आहे.
essay.en: But what if the Sadguru has not yet been met? Until that meeting comes, we must go on remembering the Name; for it is that very remembrance which will bring the meeting about{{7}}. Waiting is not a precondition — the Name is itself the road.

essay.mr: आणि संतांचें मापहि तेंच आहे — भगवंताचें अनुसंधान व अखंड नामस्मरण याशिवाय त्यांना कोणतीहि गोष्ट प्रिय नाहीं{{13}}.
essay.en: And that is the measure of the saints too — nothing whatever is dear to them except unbroken attention to God and ceaseless remembrance of the Name{{13}}.

essay.mr: म्हणून शोधायला निघण्याची गरज नाहीं. आपल्या हृदयामध्यें अखंड नामाची ज्योत तेवत ठेवा, सद्गुरु तुमचा शोध घेत येतील{{14}}.
essay.en: So there is no need to set out searching. Keep the flame of the unbroken Name burning in your heart; the Sadguru will come seeking you{{14}}.

steps.mr: भेटीची वाट न पाहतां नामस्मरण चालू ठेवावें.
steps.en: Go on with the Name without waiting for the meeting.

steps.mr: हृदयांत अखंड नामाची ज्योत तेवत ठेवावी.
steps.en: Tend the flame — keep it unbroken in the heart.

steps.mr: नामस्मरण त्याच्या सत्तेनें होतें; कर्तेपण आपलें नाहीं.
steps.en: The remembrance happens by his power; the doing is not yours.

begin_today.close_mr: सद्गुरूचा शोध घ्यायला निघावें लागत नाहीं; ज्योत तेवती ठेवली कीं तेच येतात.
begin_today.close_en: You do not have to go looking for the Sadguru. Keep the flame lit, and he comes.

practice_actions.today: Do not postpone the Name until you have a teacher. Today's remembrance is what brings the teacher.
Return to it often enough that it never quite goes out — a flame, not an appointment.
When you notice the thought \u201cI am doing this\u201d, let it go and carry on.
